subject: Deployment mode decision worksheet — SampleCorp follow-up
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Reid <alex.reid@samplecorp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deployment mode decision worksheet — SampleCorp follow-up

Hi Alex / Maya,

Thanks again for the call this morning — good discussion and helpful context about where SampleCorp is headed. Short recap and suggested next steps so we can align on the deployment option (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC) and the compliance artifacts you'll need.

Call recap (high level):
- Primary goal: ingest and serve PHI for clinical workflows (low-latency inference).
- Compliance needs: HIPAA with BAA, SOC 2 Type II evidence, audit-log access for vendor assessments.
- Preference mentioned: strong preference for VPC/private hosting to keep traffic inside our cloud boundary, but cost will drive final decision.
- Timeline: targeting pilot in Q3, production later in Q4.

Questions we need you to confirm so we can prioritize the right path:
1) Which deployment option do you prefer if pricing is not a constraint? (Hosted API, Redwood Dedicated, Private VPC/on-prem)
2) Do you require a signed BAA before any non-production data is shared with Redwood?
3) Any specific data residency or region restrictions (e.g., must run in us-west-2)?

Proposed next steps (actionable):
- I will circulate a short evidence checklist for SOC2/BAA items (attached).
- Rishi (security) and Monica (CS) will join a 30m follow-up to walk through technical constraints and evidence expectations.
- If you confirm Private VPC preference, we’ll scope network connectivity and a high-level cost estimate for Dedicated vs Private.

Attachments: redwood_evidence_checklist_v1.pdf (prelim checklist of SOC2/BAA artifacts we can provide).

Could you confirm answers to the three questions above and share your vendor security questionnaire if you have one? If convenient, propose 30-min slots next week for the technical deep-dive.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[d] 415-555-0162 | dylan.brooks@redwood.ai

From: Alex Reid <alex.reid@samplecorp.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.p@samplecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode decision worksheet — SampleCorp follow-up

Thanks Dylan — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Deployment preference: we prefer Private VPC (customer-managed VPC peering) for production because the data stays within our cloud account. For an initial pilot we are open to Dedicated capacity in Redwood if it reduces integration time, but not Hosted API for PHI.

2) BAA: yes, we require a signed BAA before we send any PHI to a vendor. We can discuss scope (pilot vs production) but the legal team wants the BAA in place early.

3) Data residency: US only, ideally us-west-2.

Timeline: aim to run a limited pilot starting in late August / early September and expand if the pilot meets our performance and audit needs.

I attached our vendor security questionnaire (samplecorp_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx) — it’s fairly detailed. Can you confirm which SOC2 artifacts you can share (e.g., type II report, complementary user controls)? Also tell us the expected lead time for providing SOC2 evidence and for setting up a Private VPC connection.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Reid
VP Product, SampleCorp
alex.reid@samplecorp.com

Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deployment mode decision worksheet — SampleCorp follow-up

Got it — thanks for the clear answers and for the questionnaire, Alex. Quick responses and proposed plan:

- BAA: yes, Redwood signs a BAA for PHI; legal can share a standard BAA template. We can scope it to pilot data if that helps speed things up.
- SOC2 artifacts: we can provide a SOC2 Type II report for our control period and a SOC2 summary of controls; some raw evidence is redacted but we provide attestations and a controls matrix.
- Private VPC setup: typical lead time is 3–4 weeks to provision networking and test connectivity for a pilot (could be faster with a clear network contact).

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) We’ll schedule a 30m technical + security sync this week (Rishi will own the session).
2) I’m attaching the evidence checklist (redwood_evidence_checklist_v1.pdf) which maps your questionnaire to the artifacts we can deliver; please flag gaps.
3) We’ll open a HubSpot deal and attach your questionnaire / our checklist for tracking: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/SC-2042
4) If you want a price-comparison for Dedicated vs Private VPC for the pilot, Monica will follow up with ballpark numbers.

Attachments: redwood_evidence_checklist_v1.pdf

Best,
Dylan

Alex / Dylan — looping in from security to outline what we can provide and suggested follow-up.

What we can provide now:
- SOC2 Type II report (redacted) for the most recent 12-month period — available under NDA/secure share.
- Controls matrix mapping (how Redwood meets the common trust criteria).
- BAA template (standard) and description of how we handle PHI in Private VPC and Dedicated modes.
- Audit-log access: we can provide per-tenant logs for Dedicated and Private VPC; Hosted has an aggregated logging option with limited tenant-level detail.

Notes on timelines:
- SOC2 report sharing: once NDA in place, we can provide within 2 business days via secure share.
- Private VPC networking: engineering needs 2–3 weeks to provision and test peering, plus 1 week for extra QA and performance tuning.
- Dedicated capacity: can be stood up in ~1 week for pilot but will require separate networking steps for secure egress.

Drive link with sample artifacts and our controls matrix: https://drive.redwood.ai/share/soc2-artifacts-placeholder

Proposed next step: 30-min technical + security sync on Wed 21 Jul, 09:00–09:30 PT. Please confirm and we’ll send a calendar invite.

-Rishi

- We will sign an NDA to receive the SOC2 materials; legal prefers the BAA signed before pilot but can review the BAA template you provide and give feedback quickly.

I attached our vendor questionnaire for reference again. Looking forward to the call — Alex
